title: ACP actors and trust boundaries
caption: Five zones. The agent platform calls the merchant's checkout API with a bilateral bearer key, gets a vault token from a PSP, and receives HMAC-signed order events. The merchant stays merchant of record and charges through its own PSP. Numbers follow the main flow.
alt: Flowchart. The buyer confirms in the agent interface. The agent reads the merchant's /.well-known/acp.json without authentication, then calls the merchant checkout API to create, update and complete a session with a bearer key. The agent sends the card and an allowance to the PSP or vault Delegate Payment endpoint and gets a vault token. The merchant charges the token through its own PSP, which accepts it only inside the allowance. The merchant sends HMAC-signed order events to the agent's webhook receiver and pushes products to the agent's Feed API. The agent can call a 3DS authentication provider for step-up.
